name: Red Hill Shopping Center
summary: Red Hill Shopping Center is a community-focused retail destination in the heart of San Anselmo, serving as a convenient hub for residents of this charming Marin County town. The center offers a welcoming, small-town shopping experience along Sir Francis Drake Boulevard.
demographics: Red Hill Shopping Center serves the affluent Marin County community of San Anselmo, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes significantly above the national average. The trade area draws residents from San Anselmo and neighboring towns like Fairfax and Ross, with a demographic profile skewing toward educated homeowners aged 35-65 who value convenience and quality. Shoppers typically seek everyday services and specialty retail in a walkable, community-oriented setting that reflects the area's small-town charm and environmental consciousness.
description: Red Hill Shopping Center stands as the heart of San Anselmo's retail landscape, serving as a beloved community gathering place along Sir Francis Drake Boulevard. Located in one of Marin County's most charming towns, this neighborhood shopping destination embodies the relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere that defines San Anselmo. The center provides convenient access to essential services and specialty retailers for residents and visitors exploring this picturesque area known for its beautiful weather and vibrant downtown. With its prime location and community-focused approach, Red Hill Shopping Center has established itself as an integral part of daily life in San Anselmo, offering a blend of practical amenities within a welcoming, small-town setting. The center's commitment to serving the local community is evident in its accessible layout and diverse tenant mix that caters to the needs of Marin County families.
